identity.question: Will Hyperliquid HIP-3 open interest hit $9B in 2026?

frozen_rule.source: Artemis Analytics, Hyperliquid page tab=hip_3; chart “HIP-3 DEXs by Open Interest”; value is “Total” when hovering a daily bar; daily value final once next day point is published; if source permanently unavailable use reliable public sources.

facts: Gamma API confirmed exact market identity, rule text, createdAt and resolution source at retrieval 2026-10-20 08:53:58.748Z. This is a daily-series maximum test since 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, subject to next-day finalization, not a current-spot test.

Official Hyperliquid API documentation defines POST /info request type metaAndAssetCtxs with optional dex (empty string means first perp DEX); it describes the response as per-asset contexts including openInterest and mark price. Therefore the endpoint is current per-asset context, not by itself a historical daily total.

Official HIP-3 docs define builder-deployed perp DEXs. Official deployer-actions documentation states notional open-interest caps use sum of absolute position size times mark price, aggregated across assets within a DEX. This is technical context, but does not establish Artemis chart’s exact display implementation or cross-DEX aggregation/double-counting convention.

facts: Official Hyperliquid docs and API captures in this pass do not provide historical open-interest series. No current OI total or historical maximum was calculated. The 2026 window is incomplete as of retrieval date; failure to retrieve the series is not evidence that threshold has or has not been reached.
